provisional_assumptions: mono-element & Vanguard resonances are attack-SPEED on Normal only; normal timing uses the provisional s_per_hit(atk_spd) formula pending empirical animation-duration data
mono ramp factors: 10-stack=0.7, 3-stack=0.5 (sustained fraction of max stacks)
